Capture provenance

Report and extraction coverage

Archive downloads

Archive links are relative to this HTML file. Keep the catalogue folder, reports and text beside the root portal. SQLite includes source records, extracted page text and findings; use a SQLite reader. Catalogue exports reflect the embedded snapshot, while archive files may have been updated since this build.

Official ratings & inspection reference

CIW introduced published ratings in April 2025. Its published labels are Excellent, Good, Requires Improvement and Requires Significant Improvement. A missing rating is not evidence of poor care.

Official reference pages are online sources, not external resources needed to run this portal. The local guidance manifest, when archived, identifies offline reference PDFs; consult the data dictionary for methodology and schema.

How to use this responsibly

  • This is the adult care home directory cohort, not every regulated service in Wales.
  • CIW publishes separate theme ratings. No overall rating, numeric quality score, ranking or inferred noncompliance is calculated. Missing ratings mean “Not published”.
  • Report dates differ between homes. Visit start, visit end, report issue and publication are distinct dates. Previous inspection metadata is historical context, not a matched report series.
  • Official CIW summaries are labelled as such and reproduce source text. When the official Summary is blank or absent, any theme-based synopsis is separately labelled as source extracts, not an official summary, and remains flagged for review. Extracted headings and automated wording labels require review against the PDF; older layouts, scanned pages and Welsh-only reports can need manual review or OCR.
  • A downloaded report is not necessarily successfully extracted. No report, unavailable synopses and failed downloads remain visible and are not treated as favourable or unfavourable evidence.
  • Topic counts are service reports mentioning a topic in embedded evidence. They overlap, are not deficiencies, and are not prevalence estimates for the whole sector.
  • The portal searches all embedded synopses, sections and selected evidence, but not page text omitted by the extractor. Open the archived full text or PDF for complete source context.
  • Conditions and action wording are reproduced without reclassifying their legal significance. Check current CIW records before any operational or regulatory decision.
